import hashlib,pathlib,time
print('AGENTOS_EVAL_READY v1',flush=True)
started=time.monotonic()
data=b'agentos-evaluation-v1\n'*10000
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/proof.bin')
p.write_bytes(data)
assert p.read_bytes()==data
total=sum(i*i for i in range(100000))
proof=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()+str(total).encode()).hexdigest()
time.sleep(max(0.0,1.0-(time.monotonic()-started)))
print('AGENTOS_EVAL_COMPLETE '+proof,flush=True)
